# Psalm 31 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.

**2** In-You, YHWH, I-take-refuge; let-me-never be-put-to-shame; in-Your-righteousness deliver-me.

**3** Incline Your-ear to-me; quickly rescue-me. Be to-me a-rock of-refuge, a-fortress-house to-save-me.

**4** For my-rock and-my-fortress [are] You; and-for-Your-name's-sake You-lead-me and-guide-me.

**5** You-bring-me-out of-the-net they-have-hidden for-me, for You [are] my-refuge.

**6** Into-Your-hand I-commit my-spirit; You-have-redeemed-me, YHWH, God of-truth.

**7** I-hate those-who-regard worthless idols; but-I trust in-YHWH.

**8** I-will-be-glad and-rejoice in-Your-steadfast-love, because You-have-seen my-affliction; You-have-known the-distresses of-my-soul.

**9** And-You-have-not given-me-over into-the-hand of-the-enemy; You-have-set my-feet in-a-broad-place.

**10** Be-gracious to-me, YHWH, for distress [is] to-me; my-eye wastes-away with-grief — my-soul and-my-body.

**11** For my-life is-spent with-sorrow, and-my-years with-groaning; my-strength fails because-of my-iniquity, and-my-bones waste-away.

**12** Because-of all my-adversaries I-have-become a-reproach, and-to my-neighbors exceedingly, and-a-dread to-my-acquaintances; those-seeing-me in-the-street flee from-me.

**13** I-am-forgotten like-a-dead-man, out-of-mind; I-am like-a-vessel that-is-destroyed.

**14** For I-hear the-whispering of-many — terror on-every-side — as-they-conspire together against-me; they-plot to-take my-life.

**15** But-I trust in-You, YHWH; I-say, 'You [are] my-God.'

**16** In-Your-hand [are] my-times; deliver-me from-the-hand of-my-enemies and-from-my-pursuers.

**17** Make-Your-face shine upon-Your-servant; save-me in-Your-steadfast-love.

**18** YHWH, let-me-not be-put-to-shame, for I-have-called-upon-You; let-the-wicked be-put-to-shame; let-them-be-silent in-Sheol.

**19** Let-the-lying lips be-mute, which-speak against the-righteous arrogantly, with-pride and-contempt.

**20** How great [is] Your-goodness which You-have-stored-up for-those-who-fear-You, which You-have-worked for-those-who-take-refuge in-You, before the-sons of-man!

**21** You-hide-them in-the-hiding-place of-Your-presence from-the-plots of-man; You-shelter-them in-a-booth from-the-strife of-tongues.

**22** Blessed [is] YHWH, for He-has-made-wonderful His-steadfast-love to-me in-a-besieged city.

**23** And-I said in-my-alarm, 'I-am-cut-off from-before Your-eyes.' But-indeed You-heard the-voice of-my-supplications when-I-cried to-You.

**24** Love YHWH, all His-faithful-ones. YHWH preserves the-faithful, and-repays abundantly the-one-acting in-pride.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **31:6**: Into Your hand I commit my spirit — Jesus quotes this verse from the cross (Luke 23:46). The psalm becomes the final prayer of the Crucified.

- **31:14**: 'Terror on every side' (magor missaviv) — Jeremiah's signature phrase (Jer 20:3, 10). The psalm shares vocabulary with the prophetic tradition.

— EMET
